# `eutaxy/aws`

`import { … } from "eutaxy/aws";` 12 functions and values, 13 types; each links to the file that declares it.

## Functions, classes and values

### `atLeastOncePerMessage`

`function atLeastOncePerMessage(name: string, drive: SqsDrive, effect: EffectSelector, key: string, bodyKey: string): AtLeastOnce`

Every message's `bodyKey` value must appear at least once as `key` in a selected effect. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/scenario.ts)

### `atMostOncePerKey`

`function atMostOncePerKey(name: string, effect: EffectSelector, key: string): AtMostOncePerKey`

No two selected effects share the value at `key` (a dot path into the effect's payload): nothing happened twice for one key, a payment recorded twice, a message sent twice. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/core/src/delivery-invariants.ts)

### `createAwsPlatform`

`function createAwsPlatform(options: AwsPlatformOptions): Platform`

The AWS Lambda platform for `check`: SQS delivery with redelivery up to the queue's maxReceiveCount, every AWS SDK call one effect redirected to the local client of its class, and DynamoDB tables reset and snapshotted per run. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/platform.ts)

### `defineAwsScenario`

`function defineAwsScenario(input: AwsScenarioInput): ScenarioSpec`

Build and validate a scenario spec for the AWS platform; throws with every problem listed. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/scenario.ts)

### `dynamoRows`

`function dynamoRows(table: string, where?: readonly RowCondition[]): StateQuery`

Rows of a table in the end-of-run snapshot. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/scenario.ts)

### `dynamoTable`

`function dynamoTable(name: string, partitionKey: KeyDef, sortKey?: KeyDef): TableSpec`

A DynamoDB table the scenario uses, by name and key schema: created empty before each run and snapshotted after it. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/scenario.ts)

### `dynamoWrite`

`function dynamoWrite(table: string, op: "PutItem" | "UpdateItem" | "DeleteItem" | "BatchWriteItem" | "TransactWriteItems" = "PutItem"): EffectSelector`

Selects committed writes to a table: results whose `written` is at least 1. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/scenario.ts)

### `resetTables`

`function resetTables(client: DynamoDBClient, tables: readonly TableSpec[]): Promise<void>`

Drop and recreate the tables, so every run starts from the same empty state. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/dynamodb.ts)

### `runAwsDifferential`

`function runAwsDifferential(spec: ScenarioSpec, options: AwsPlatformOptions): Promise<DifferentialResult>`

Run a scenario through Eutaxy's proxies and again with the handler calling the raw local clients, and compare the attempts and the final tables: the check that the proxies change nothing the handler sees. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/differential.ts)

### `snapshotTables`

`function snapshotTables(client: DynamoDBClient, tables: readonly TableSpec[]): Promise<{ readonly [table: string]: readonly JsonValue[] }>`

Every item of every table, unmarshalled and sorted canonically. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/dynamodb.ts)

### `sqs`

`function sqs(queue: string, messages: readonly SqsMessage[], options: { readonly maxReceiveCount?: number } = {}): SqsDrive`

Drive the Lambda with these messages from an SQS queue; `maxReceiveCount` defaults to 3. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/scenario.ts)

### `sqsDelete`

`function sqsDelete(queue: string): EffectSelector`

Selects the implicit deletion of each successfully handled message. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/scenario.ts)

## Types

### `AttemptRecord`

`type AttemptRecord`

A type, not an interface, so it is JSON data the comparison takes as it is. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/differential.ts)

### `AwsPlatformOptions`

`interface AwsPlatformOptions`

What `createAwsPlatform` needs: the handler, local SDK clients by class name, and the function's name and region. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/platform.ts)

### `AwsScenarioInput`

`interface AwsScenarioInput`

The input to `defineAwsScenario`: the handler, the SQS drive, the tables, the externals, the invariants and the bounds. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/scenario.ts)

### `DifferentialResult`

`interface DifferentialResult`

What `runAwsDifferential` found: whether the proxied run and the raw run agree, each side's attempts and tables, the differences when they do not, and any reason the proxied side was UNSUPPORTED. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/differential.ts)

### `KeyDef`

`type KeyDef`

A type alias, not an interface, so it satisfies PlatformData's JSON index signature. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/dynamodb.ts)

### `LambdaContext`

`interface LambdaContext`

The context object Lambda passes beside the event: the request id, the function's identity and its remaining time. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/lambda.ts)

### `SqsBatchResponse`

`interface SqsBatchResponse`

What a handler may return to report partial batch failures: the message ids in `batchItemFailures` stay on the queue and are redelivered, the others are deleted. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/lambda.ts)

### `SqsDrive`

`interface SqsDrive`

Drive the Lambda with these SQS messages, one record per invocation. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/scenario.ts)

### `SqsEvent`

`interface SqsEvent`

The event an SQS-triggered Lambda receives: its records, one per message in the batch. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/lambda.ts)

### `SqsHandler`

`type SqsHandler`

An SQS-triggered Lambda handler: async or not, returning nothing or a partial batch response. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/lambda.ts)

### `SqsMessage`

`interface SqsMessage`

One message to deliver: its body, and an id (default `msg-<n>`, by position). [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/scenario.ts)

### `SqsRecord`

`interface SqsRecord`

One SQS message as Lambda's event source hands it to the function, with the attributes AWS sets. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/lambda.ts)

### `TableSpec`

`interface TableSpec`

A table to create before each run. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/aws/src/dynamodb.ts)
